{{Top|leg}}
The '''remote interface''' used a wireless signal to completely bypass security hardware and countermeasures. However, the signal used a significant portion of the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] power to maintain and therefore resulted in a loss of cognitive awareness.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.

*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
